title: M006f human disposition and cumulative session ledger
hypothesis: An explicit human disposition can be cryptographically bound to an exact M006f review dossier and aggregated into a cumulative reviewed-session ledger without allowing software to infer disposition or promotion.
result: PASS: explicit human ACCEPTED disposition verified against the exact dossier; cumulative ledger independently verified the pair and contained 1 reviewed session, 1 accepted session and 2 replay events. Automatic disposition and promotion remain false and promotion authority remains NONE.
